titulo: Mientras with past tenses (indicative and subjunctive)
subtitulo: Mientras tú cocinabas, yo lavaba / Me dejaba salir mientras hiciera la tarea.
regla: Mientras + past indicative = while (two actions at the same time): mientras tú veías la tele, yo lavaba los trastes. Mientras (que) + past subjunctive = as long as (a condition): me dejaba salir mientras hiciera la tarea.

filas: Me dejaba salir mientras hiciera la tarea.

bloques.texto: The simultaneous actions are often both in the imperfect; the main one can be preterite if it's a complete event.
Tip: indicative = at the same time; subjunctive = on condition.

lista.es: ==Mientras== tú ==veías== la tele, yo lavaba los trastes.
lista.en: While you were watching TV, I was washing the dishes.

lista.es: Los niños jugaron en el parque ==mientras== los adultos ==tomábamos== café.
lista.en: The kids played in the park while we adults had coffee.

lista.es: ==Mientras== ella ==regañaba== a su hija, nosotras volteamos para otro lado.
lista.en: While she was scolding her daughter, we looked away.
Their romance was lovely while it lasted.

lista.es: De niña, mi mamá me dejaba ver la tele ==mientras que hiciera== la tarea antes.
lista.en: As a kid, my mom let me watch TV as long as I did my homework first.

lista.es: Te habría prestado el carro ==mientras== me lo ==devolvieras== el lunes.
lista.en: I'd have lent you the car as long as you returned it on Monday.

filas.t: Mientras yo cocinara, él puso la mesa. (at the same time)
Mientras yo cocinaba, él puso la mesa.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _While I was sleeping, it rained._
Complete: _Me dejaban salir mientras ___ (volver, yo) antes de las diez._
In Spanish: _We talked while we were walking._
